policy: Rejected C003 candidates are preserved to prevent renamed rediscovery.

entries.title: Deterministic Isolation Alone Decides SAT
entries.reason: A deterministic family that isolates a unique minimum satisfying assignment does not by itself decide whether any satisfying assignment exists or find the isolated witness without an additional decision or optimization mechanism.
entries.salvage: A descendant must pair isolation with an independently specified polynomial-time unique-witness detector or extractor and account for all queries.

entries.title: Unrestricted Polynomial d-DNNF Compiler
entries.reason: An unrestricted polynomial-time compiler can first solve SAT and then emit a constant true or false d-DNNF, so the statement merely restates P = NP through solve-and-encode.
entries.salvage: H016 restricts the compiler to a finite bounded-radius grammar with constant-size semantic certificates.

entries.title: Residual Quotient with Free Canonicalization
entries.reason: Claiming polynomially many residual equivalence classes is meaningless if equivalence testing or canonicalization is left as an unbounded semantic oracle.
entries.salvage: H018 requires an explicit bounded certificate language and polynomial-time canonical representatives.
